attributes.title: Level 2

subgroups.name: Discover

steps.text: Watch this video to learn about using for loops in your code to better control how loops run in your projects.

questions.hint: Which type of loop will run a specific number of times, then stop?
questions.title: [Select one]  Which loop is used to run a chunk of code that repeats until a specific condition is met in JavaScript?
questions.correctResponse: In JavaScript, a for loop is used to run a chunk of code that repeats until a specific condition is met.

questions.hint: What do each of the for loop’s expressions represent?
questions.title: [Matching ]  Match the expression to its name in the code below:
questions.correctResponse: Remember, the initialization expression sets an initial value for the counter variable. The run condition expression sets the condition that needs to be true, in order for the loop to run. The increment expression sets the value that the counter variable will change by after each iteration of the loop.

questions.hint: Which operator decreases the counter variable each time the for loop runs?
questions.title: [Select one]  Which operator should be used in a for loop to count down from 5 to 0, decreasing the counter variable by 1 each time the loop runs?
questions.correctResponse: A decrement operator will always decrease the value of a variable by 1. If a loop should count down by 1 after each iteration, then a decrement operator should be used.

questions.title: [Open response]  What is something new that you can use a for loop for in the JavaScript editor?
questions.correctResponse: Those sound like great ideas! Can’t wait to see what you create!

subgroups.title: For Loops!
subgroups.introduction: Watch this video to learn about using for loops in your code to better control how loops run in your projects.

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 2 of Purple Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about for loops. Using for loops, you can code things to happen multiple times. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 2:

badges.title: Getting Loopy
badges.description: Control how a loop runs using its 3 expressions in JavaScript.

badges.title: Here We Go Again
badges.description: Write a for loop that starts at zero and counts up using an increment operator.

badges.title: Where it Stops, Nobody Knows
badges.description: Write a for loop that runs a random number of times.

badges.title: Sugar, We’re Going Down
badges.description: Write a for loop that starts with a number larger than zero and counts down using a decrement operator.

badges.title: Double the Fun
badges.description: Nest a for loop inside another for loop.

badges.title: Memory Palace
badges.description: Save the game’s high score.

badges.title: Trophy Room
badges.description: Display the high score to the user.

badges.title: Depth Perception
badges.description: Set a sprite’s z-position so it appears in the front of a scene.
